experiment: DCF-20B escalate-on-abstention, gated test of a hypothesis formed in explore20.json
policy: BP for every query (one launch); exact only for queries whose BP posterior lies strictly inside (0.2, 0.8) (second launch when any); no tunable parameters
lambda_meaning: utility per millisecond of modelled kernel time; declared in advance as the compute prices where the exploratory traces suggested a crossover
seed_note: fresh: no overlap with world-selection (750000+), DCF-20 dev/test (760000+, 770000+) or exploratory (880000+) seeds

gates.G1: at each declared lambda separately, escalate-on-abstention objective exceeds the better of fixed_bp and fixed_exact (chosen per condition with hindsight) in more than half of the 6 conditions
